# Anaesthesia Core

> Unified FRCA Primary, Final, and FFICM revision resource: structured topics, diagrams, quizzes, and viva practice across physics, physiology, pharmacology, clinical anaesthesia, intensive care, and perioperative medicine.

Anaesthesia Core organises the UK anaesthesia and intensive care curricula into six sections, with exam-tagged topics (Primary / Final / FFICM), interactive diagrams, worked examples, key learning points, sourced references, and viva practice tools.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): Overview and entry point.
- [Revise](/revise): Topic revision hub.
- [Topic Map](/map): Visual map of all curriculum topics.
- [Progress](/progress): Personal revision progress tracker.
- [Viva Hub](/viva): Viva practice with AI examiner.
- [Viva Library](/viva/library): Library of viva scenarios.
- [Drugs Library](/drugs): Anaesthesia drug reference.
- [Podcasts](/podcasts): Topic audio summaries.

## Sections

- [Physics](/physics): Measurement, equipment, and applied physics for anaesthesia.
- [Physiology](/physiology): Cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, neuro, and applied physiology.
- [Pharmacology](/pharmacology): Anaesthetic drugs, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics.
- [Clinical Anaesthesia](/clinical): Subspecialty anaesthesia, airway, and regional.
- [Intensive Care](/intensive-care): FFICM-aligned critical care topics.
- [Perioperative Medicine](/perioperative): Comorbidities, assessment, and enhanced recovery.
- [Anatomy](/anatomy): Applied anatomy for anaesthesia and regional blocks.
- [Chemistry](/chemistry): Underlying chemistry for pharmacology and physics.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full machine-readable list of public routes.
